_comment: PORT campaign: bridge 3 of IBM Spyre deeptools — SentientIR -> ProgIR, dcc pass D76.
The scope is ONE self-contained translation unit, cpp/bridge3.cpp, holding the 130 function
bodies to port, extracted verbatim from dcc/src/Conversion/SentientToProgIR/ and each preceded
by a banner giving its entry number and its ORIGINAL dcc/src/<file>:<line>.
There is no MLIR, LLVM or dcc header anywhere in this campaign. cpp/prelude.inc catalogues the
45 qualified scopes and 378 external calls the bodies reach so the unit is self-describing.
It carries names only — the behaviour to port lives in the bodies.
_comment_verified: ✅ THE EXTRACTION IS VERIFIED UNTRUNCATED: 130 of 130. tools/verify_extract3.py re-derives every
function's end from the authority with its OWN brace matcher (it does not import the
extractor's) and compares line counts, non-whitespace character counts and full content; it also
asserts each body's last line closes its function and matches the authority's, so no body was
brace-padded. Two negative controls are caught: a tail cut re-balanced with a bare `}` and a
brace-neutral 4-line cut from a body's middle.
This is the check bridge 2 did not have: its extract truncated 366 of 384 bodies while reporting
'verbatim, 12 sampled, none differed', because it re-sliced the source with the SAME
_comment_excluded: 36 of the conversion directory's 166 definitions are NOT in bridge3.cpp, listed with a reason
each in EXCLUSIONS.tsv. The criterion is what a Rust struct field or a const already is, NOT
33  header inlines of 1-4 lines over a member — a struct field in Rust, not a function.
Two of those 33 are comment bookkeeping, and a comment is debug-only in the reference
(setComment drops the text unless enable_debug_flag, progir.h:322-330).
1  regDefChecking — `return false;`, a compile-time debug constant, a `const bool` in Rust
1  initializeOutputStream — ostream copyfmt/rdbuf plumbing; this crate never configures a
2  createSentientToProgIRPass (both overloads) — MLIR pass-registry factories. scratchy's
#[forward] runs the whole pipeline at macro expansion: no pass manager exists at run time
Nothing is excluded for being hard. getUnitRegionIndex is KEPT despite living in a header,
because its body is a real decision rule with a -1 sentinel.
_comment_not_this_campaign: ⛔⛔ dcc/src/Transform/Sentient/ — 32,766 lines of D29-D75 passes — IS A SEPARATE, LARGER BODY OF
WORK AND MUST NOT BE PULLED IN. Those passes rewrite SentientIR IN PLACE before D76 runs:
LiveRangeReduction, OpRerolling, LoopRolling, and forty more. A ported function that depends on
state they establish is ported AS THE REFERENCE WRITES IT, with the dependency recorded in the
commit message. Do not port the pass, and do not invent the state.
